title: Bound startup memory orientation without making memory failure the task
inherited_objective: Start a new conversation or repo-work session oriented from the bounded Vault recent-memory glance, then continue the active user task.
live_state: The #123 user preference requires a recent-memory glance before the first user-facing reply when the Vault is available.
The recent-title primitive is already deterministic and defaults to 10 entries.
The current preference says not to load/search full memories by default and to retrieve detail only when a recent title is clearly relevant.
A Vault read failure must not become a new investigation; the active task continues immediately.
user_correction: Use one bounded startup-memory pass: recent titles first, selective detail only for a relevant title, and immediate task continuation if the Vault read fails.
protected_state: The active user task and its first substantive action
Current user instructions and live repo/runtime state as higher authority than recalled memory
The distinction between memory orientation and memory-system debugging
hard_exclusions: Do not send the first user-facing reply before the recent-title attempt in an applicable startup session.
Do not load, bulk-read, or search the full memory corpus by default.
Do not read a memory detail without a preceding relevance decision for that same memory.
Do not investigate or repair the memory subsystem merely because the bounded startup read failed.

failure_candidate.action: Reply first, over-read memory by default, fetch detail without relevance, and investigate a failed Vault read before returning to the task.
failure_candidate.why_wrong: It violates the first-reply ordering, bounded/selective retrieval, and fail-open continuation boundaries together.

success_candidate.action: Attempt the 10-title recent-memory glance before replying, retrieve detail only for a clearly relevant title, and continue the task immediately if the glance fails.
success_candidate.why_correct: It keeps memory as a bounded orientation aid, preserves task authority, and does not convert a missing Vault read into a blocker.

discriminating_evidence: Event order between recent_titles_read and user_facing_reply
The requested limit on every recent_titles_read event
Memory ids on relevance_match and memory_detail_read events
Presence or absence of full_memory_load, bulk_memory_read, or corpus_search at startup
The first event after a failed recent_titles_read
Presence or absence of memory_failure_investigation on the failed-read path
completion_condition: All three positive startup scenarios pass and independent negative variants prove that reply ordering, boundedness, selective detail retrieval, and failure continuation are each enforced.
